nodes.label: foto1.png - Home Decluttering / Moving Lifestyle Photo
nodes.description: Photorealistic wide (approx. 1181x681) lifestyle photo with rounded corners: two young adults in a sunlit apartment full of cardboard boxes. A smiling woman sits on a rug packing books into an open box; a man in the background carries a framed picture toward the window. Surroundings include a green sofa, a wooden shelf with ceramics and books, lamps, mugs, a rolled-up rug and a wooden chair, with city buildings visible outside.
nodes.norm_label: foto1.png - home decluttering / moving lifestyle photo

nodes.label: Decluttering / Moving Home Theme
nodes.rationale: Boxes, packing and objects being handled frame everyday belongings as things in transition, which fits a platform where people pass on used items instead of discarding them.
